Over the weekend, the US military relied on Anthropic's powerful AI model,
Claude,[ to help support the launch](https://www.axios.com/newsletters/axios-
am-f0954cb2-2f31-4426-87fd-050095005344.html?chunk=2&utm_term=twsocialshare#story2)
of its brutal attack on Iran. The Pentagon used Claude despite the fact that
just hours earlier, the Trump administration declared it would end use of
Anthropic's AI tools after a spat over the government's desire to mass-surveil
US citizens using its AI model.

The dispute between Anthropic and the US government has devolved into a
chaotic split that has upended Silicon Valley, thrown the government into
confusion, and kicked off a national debate about the ethics of AI in warfare.
